svg.text: From Neuron to AGI, Built from Scratch
27 notebooks, from a single perceptron to a coding agent: every piece written by hand, checked, then reused.
A library feature is used only after it has been built from scratch and checked against it
own autograd → torch.autograd · own attention → nn.MultiheadAttention · own LoRA → peft · own agent loop → no framework
Our GPT class + OpenAI's weights = Hugging Face's logits
